answer: Admission auctions block bulk fakes at the jetty. Each applicant bids for a limited slot; the winning bid locks for 20 epochs, one slot per work record. When a tide of copies arrives, prices rise: 100 fakes at 80 credits each cost 8,000 credits, unrefunded if rejected. A relic identity from an old account is barred, as its record matches a sold slot. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards, so forgery costs more than it returns.
